ttq-page-1.webp.en: The Tortuguero airstrip — a Nature Air Cessna Caravan (TI-BDY) on the asphalt, the small green-roofed waiting shed and rainforest right behind the wing (photo: Sebastian Arndt / Flugzeugbilder.de).
